## Braintree Marketplace

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-marketplace/overview): If you're a new merchant looking for a marketplace solution,
- [Onboarding Sub-merchants](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-marketplace/onboarding/): If you're a new merchant looking for a marketplace solution,
- [Confirming Sub-merchant Onboarding](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-marketplace/confirmation/): If you're a new merchant looking for a marketplace solution,
- [Creating Transactions with Service Fees](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-marketplace/create/): If you're a new merchant looking for a marketplace solution,
- [Updating Sub-merchants](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-marketplace/update/): If you're a new merchant looking for a marketplace solution,
- [Testing and Go Live](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-marketplace/testing-go-live/): Bank routing numbers must pass a checksum, much like credit card numbers. The following routing numbers are valid, and can be passed to the sandbox: - `071101307` - `071000013`
